title: ObservationRecord (pre-verification archive)
$comment: Structural residue of the effect.* rules (P0-5). The append-only artifact for pre-verification archival (effect.archive.observation-record): it says 'these exact bytes were observed at this time' and nothing more — coverage is pinned NOT_EVALUATED and there is no acceptance field to misread. Actionable consumption goes through a DecisionRecord join (effect.archive.decision-record); a store whose consumers read observations directly has bypassed the release gate. $defs are inlined (no cross-file $ref).

wireVariantId.$comment: The exact variant observed (identity.variant.immutable-set); a body-only archive cannot be joined to variant-exact evidence later.

payloadDigest.$comment: Digest of the exact payload bytes AND the content address of the payload blob persisted in the same append as this record (effect.archive.observation-record: the record carries the exact variant and payload); a record whose blob is missing is torn, not an observation.

coverage.$comment: claims.coverage.three-value: an observation asserts existence, never an evaluation outcome.

deliveryMetadata.$comment: Same shape as quarantine-entry.json deliveryMetadata when the observation originated from a delivery.
